sourceSentences: Vel'Koz fires a plasma bolt in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and slow [slows] them by 70% decaying over a duration.
Plasma Fission can be recast after 0.25 seconds while the bolt is in flight, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range.
Plasma Fission can reach a maximum 1595 units diagonally (ignoring the split missile's width and enemy hitbox radius), reaching this distance after a total of about ~1.65 seconds.
Vel'Koz cracks a rift in the target direction that opens after a 0.25-second delay, cascading through the area over 0.65 seconds to deal magic damage to enemies within.
After 0.75 seconds [Estimated], the rift violently collapses, dealing magic damage to enemies within and granting sight of the surrounding area for 0.25 seconds.
Unbreakable [Braum] and Wind Wall [Yasuo] will block the ripple and prevent the rift from forming further, but they will not destroy the section that was created already.
If Tectonic Disruption is cast in close proximity of Vel'Koz, the anomaly will also slightly airborne [knock back] enemies hit in the direction of the cast.
While the effect is fully prevented by blocking the missile (e.g. with Unbreakable [Braum] and Wind Wall [Yasuo]), the missile may not be destroyed visually.
Applying 3 Organic Deconstruction [Vel'Koz] stacks to an enemy champion marks them as Researched for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and ability hits against them.
Researched [Vel'Koz] enemies take true damage instead.
Vel'Koz will sight [reveal] himself if the ray is near an enemy champion.
Being able to detonate your Q early means your opponent's never safe even behind their own minions.
And because this deals damage twice, both of them can apply one stack of his passive.
For combos, start with Q into W and E. Attack into your second W before attacking away, following up with alt if you have it.
And your super longrange combo is to use Q on an angle into your ultimate for massive damage.
